description: The CT Cranium DICOM scan is already loaded in InVesalius 3 with default bone-window settings (window width ~406 HU). A radiologist needs to optimize this scan for brain parenchyma visualization. Complete all three steps and save the result: (1) Change the window width and window level to a brain soft-tissue window — approximately window width 80 HU and window level 40 HU — using the window/level controls in InVesalius; (2) create a new segmentation mask using a soft tissue or muscle tissue threshold preset (maximum HU ≤ 300, e.g. Soft Tissue −700–225 HU or Muscle Tissue −5–135 HU); (3) save the project via File > Save As to /home/ga/Documents/brain_study.inv3.
